look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Turn a middle leaf over and find the row of stiff prickles along the underside midrib. Inspect clasping auriculate leaf bases and small narrow yellow-flowered heads; milky sap on a fresh break.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect annual or biennial herb, leafy stem branching above, milky sap.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Alternate variable lobed gray-green leaves, clasping auricles and underside midrib row of spines.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Narrow cylindrical heads with small yellow strap-shaped ligulate florets.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Beaked flattened cypsela with white pappus; macro still needed.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Stems often glabrous to prickly; milky latex.

names: Sonchus asper: glossy, spiny-margined clasping leaves; compare underside midrib and heads.
Lactuca canadensis: check underside midrib prickles, leaf bases and fruit.
Lactuca virosa: close look-alike; compare mature fruit and leaves.
lookalikes.differences: Row of stiff spines along abaxial leaf midrib plus clasping auricles, milky latex and narrow yellow ligulate heads.
